title: ranunculus dissectus subsp. glabrescens
intro: Ranunculus dissectus subsp. glabrescens, commonly known as Yellow Water Crowfoot, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus dissectus subsp. glabrescens include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic effects, which can help in treating conditions like wounds, fever, and urinary problems. Bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
